config.schedule: 20-epoch cosine decay to 1% of initial learning rate; no early stopping
config.augmentation: uniform rotations by multiples of 90 degrees and horizontal flip with probability 0.5
config.precision: bfloat16 autocast with float32 loss; gradient norm checked for finiteness
config.loss: 0.5 samplewise Dice + 0.5 BCE; boundary variant adds 0.1 morphological boundary Dice
config.initialization: ImageNet encoder for every variant, random decoder; boundary and Gabor variants identical seed-specific initialization
config.selection: highest complete native-grid validation mean Dice; no outlier exclusion; no EMA metric selection
config.status: Exploratory development: BBBC039 test outcomes from earlier frozen models have already been inspected. No within-run test tuning. Independent confirmation remains required.
